canonical_card_face_reference.label: Orbitortoise canonical Stream Bandit TCG card-face reference
canonical_card_face_reference.usage: visual layout reference only; structured card data remains gameplay/rules authority

creature_card.art: large upper card-specific artwork window; artwork is fitted/cropped inside the renderer and never carries rules/UI text
creature_card.action_slot_count: data-driven: show Ability when present plus every canonical Attack row

bottom_right: Withdraw Cost + value directly beneath rarity

missing_artwork.behavior: render the complete real card face with an element-themed Artwork Pending window

attached_essence.display: tiny element-colored orb rail in Battle
attached_essence.source: authoritative attached essence instances + structured essence.provides visible in the viewer match state
attached_essence.normal_layout: individual resource-unit orbs while the rail fits inside its allocated card bounds
attached_essence.overflow_layout: one counted orb per present element only when the rendered rail would overflow

numeric_label_policy.rule: Every visible gameplay number must have a named property or a globally standardized labeled icon with accessible text.

printing_finish.rule: Printing/finish is cosmetic and may vary while the gameplay identity and rules stay identical.

variants.label: Alt-Art
variants.effect: alternate dedicated illustration with identical gameplay rules

battle_renderer.active_ability_ready_state: glow/pulse only when the authoritative server field_actions response includes the creature in ability_sources
battle_renderer.triggered_ability_state: display rules text but never present as a manual activation button
battle_renderer.attack_state: each canonical attack row stays visible; legal/ready state is visually explicit and insufficient Essence must explain the shortfall
battle_renderer.attack_resolution: Attack transport remains server-owned; the card renderer never decides legality or damage
battle_renderer.missing_artwork: same complete card face with Artwork Pending window; card remains readable and playable
battle_renderer.attached_essence_state: render attached effective Essence as element orbs on the Creature; compress by measured card-space overflow only
battle_renderer.attack_cost_state: render required Essence with the same element-orb identity system used by attached resources

global_renderer.source_of_truth: SB1 structured card registry + printing/art metadata
